# Play — Tuning Fork

- SudokuPad: [Tuning Fork on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Tuning Fork on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The killer cages are native. f-puzzles has no fifths line (the rule is invented), so the two lines are **cosmetic** blue
lines and the apps won't enforce them; the rules text covers them, and the answer check still works. I have not opened the
links in a browser. If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the reference picture.

Fifths lines: r1c3–r2c3–r3c3–r4c3–r5c3–r6c4–r6c5–r6c6–r5c7–r4c7–r3c7–r2c7–r1c7; r6c5–r7c5–r8c5–r9c5.

Killer cages: r2c7+r3c7 = 10; r2c3+r3c3 = 6; r3c1+r4c1+r5c1 = 11; r3c9+r4c9+r5c9 = 9; r1c2+r2c1+r2c2 = 21; r1c8+r2c8+r2c9 = 11; r8c6+r8c7 = 6; r8c3+r8c4 = 9; r7c2+r7c3 = 13; r7c7+r7c8 = 9; r5c6+r5c7 = 9; r5c3+r5c4 = 6.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
